Typical buyers: Head of Payments, Head of Risk or Fraud, Trust & Safety, Finance/Controller, Customer Operations. - Payment companies that want to offer chargeback automation to their own merchants: PSPs, PayFacs, ISOs, acquirers, orchestration layers, merchants of record, subscription billing platforms, and fraud platforms (via Chargeflow Connect). - Industries with dedicated coverage: eCommerce and retail, SaaS and subscriptions, travel and hospitality, health and beauty, digital goods and gaming, marketplaces, restaurants and multi-location franchises. - Growth-stage DTC brands on Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Magento, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, and Wix. ## Products - **Automation**: Fully automated representment. Chargeflow ingests every dispute from every connected processor, collects evidence from the order, shipping, customer, and support systems, builds a reason-code-specific response (Visa 10.x to 13.x, Mastercard 48xx, Amex, Discover), and submits it before the deadline. 100% on-time submission guarantee. 4x ROI guarantee. Pricing: 25% of recovered amount, nothing on lost disputes. https://www.chargeflow.io/products/automation - **Alerts**: Pre-chargeback deflection through Verifi RDR, Verifi CDRN, and Ethoca. Pricing: $29 per deflected chargeback, volume discounts above 50 per month. https://www.chargeflow.io/products/alerts - **Prevent**: Post-purchase, pre-fulfillment fraud and abuse screening. Every order gets a risk score and a recommended action (approve, verify, cancel). $5B+ GMV screened annually, under 0.1% false positive rate. Pricing: $0.20 per scanned transaction, first 1,000 free. https://www.chargeflow.io/products/prevent - **Insights**: Free analytics across every connected processor and store in one dashboard. Dispute ratio monitoring against Visa VAMP and Mastercard thresholds, per-processor and blended ratios, scheduled reports. https://www.chargeflow.io/products/insights - **Connect** (Chargeflow for Platforms): The same dispute engine delivered inside a payment or commerce platform. Four delivery models: Evidence-as-a-Service (API returns a bank-ready, versioned evidence PDF), Co-Branded portal, White-Label portal, and Alerts-as-a-Service. 45+ PSPs supported. Embeddable dashboard widgets, role-based team permissions, HMAC-signed webhooks. Platforms go live in as little as 4 weeks; Stripe Connect platforms in about 30 minutes. Custom enterprise pricing, no setup fees, no annual minimums. https://www.chargeflow.io/products/connect ## Enterprise Capabilities - Multi-store, multi-processor, and multi-entity coverage in one account and one dashboard. - Security: SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS in transit, MFA, OAuth 2.0, hosted on AWS with regular penetration testing. EU hosting options are available on Enterprise plans when required. - Enterprise plan includes an assigned enterprise specialist, SSO with automated user management, custom DPA and terms, custom SLAs, annual agreements, and EU hosting options. https://www.chargeflow.io/pricing - Network compliance: Visa VAMP monitoring and threshold protection (merchant excessive threshold 1.5% since April 1, 2026), Visa CE 3.0, Mastercard First-Party Trust, Ethoca and Verifi

Each code stands for a specific issue—maybe there weren't enough funds, there was suspected fraud, or a processing error occurred. These codes are crucial not just for resolving payment disputes but also for analytics and reporting in financial operations. Knowing these codes helps businesses apply the right fixes, ensuring they stick to card network rules and improve their transaction success rates.
